composition_subtypes.role: Enumerates all valid digit subsets and their permutations for hours and minutes

payload.core_composition_summary: Single-phase complete search over digit subsets using bitmasks and permutations to count distinct-digit times.
payload.rationale: The solution iterates over all possible hour and minute digit subsets, generates permutations to count base-7 numbers < n or m, and checks distinctness via bitmask AND. No DP or multi-mechanism coordination.
